text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Option A 18.0 to 18.8 s. The small white roof-pod car rolls slowly right on the flooded residential street while the brown water climbs from its wheels to over the lower wheel arches. Low tan houses, a live oak and green street signs stand behind. The caption sits just under the car over the lower water band.
